panels.prompt: Wide shot: flooded salt gallery, black brine, salt icicles; young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back wades mid-hall, torch high; three companions file along left wall, faint glowing air threads.

Action shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back waist-deep in black brine cuts down bloated pale drowned miner with long claws, brine exploding upward. Cold blue darkness.

Low angle: white light arrow shatters salt icicle cluster above young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back, shards raining beside him, black brine. Cold blue.

Wide shot: volley of crystal salt needles shoots from cave wall into translucent golden shell around young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back; half the shell cracks into golden shards. Black brine.

Low angle: hulking bald convict giant wrapped in iron chains, waist-deep in black brine, rising, chains trailing into depths; young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back faces him, sword ready.
